items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: George Traehan. I don't know if you were going to play with him.

ctx.x: I saw some picture where I thought Trae played with him. But, uh... Traehan? George Trae. The drummer. No, you didn't... We called him George Traehan. Traehan, huh? Yeah.
